[Shot 1] A static close-up of a black assault rifle resting on a sandbag at an empty outdoor shooting range on a calm afternoon. The rifle fires exactly one round: one small muzzle flash, then it is still. The camera is static and locked-off.

overall_soundscape: Foley recording, close microphone: one single punchy assault rifle gunshot, a hard sharp crack with a tight low thump, followed by a short dry outdoor echo that dies away within half a second, then silence. Nothing else is heard: no music, no speech, no voices.
